purpose: Remove the floating branch reference from the security scanner and stop GitHub Actions pinning from degrading further, without pretending the historical debt is closed.
requiredInvariants: No commit SHA may be invented; only hashes that can actually be verified may be written.
Any floating branch reference must fail the gate regardless of the count.
The floating-reference ceiling may fall but must never rise.
The matrix must state that the pinning control is NOT_MET and explain why the debt was not cleared.
No existing security gate may be weakened, disabled or excluded.
The trivy-action replacement tag must already be in proven use elsewhere in the repository.
No product code, dependency, lockfile or production configuration may change.
Merge and CI success are not REG.RU production deployment evidence.
acceptance: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master no longer appears in any workflow.
The gate fails on a floating branch and on any rise above the baseline of 1028.
Unit tests cover the passing case, both failure modes, @main and @HEAD, SHA-pinned and local references, and a missing or malformed baseline.
The gate and its tests run in CI.
SUPPLY_CHAIN_MATRIX.md records 8 of 1036 references pinned and marks the control NOT_MET.
The concurrent-scope guard accepts exactly the seven authorized paths.
